verdict.rationale: Navan offers in-platform booking from a global travel inventory with self-serve changes, and Navan Edge books trips after explicit user confirmation. Policy is applied at booking time for hotels: every hotel search shows a "price to beat" under the employee's policy limit, and the plan includes unlimited policy and approval workflows. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that flight bookings are policy-checked at booking time, documentation of how out-of-policy bookings are blocked or routed for pre-trip approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
